name: NYOCOR Co., Ltd.
summary: NYOCOR Co., Ltd. engages in the development, investment, construction, and operation of energy power plants in China. It operates photovoltaic and wind power generation plants. The company is also involved in energy storage, hydrogen energy, and smart energy businesses. It operates an approved installed capacity of 7,468 megawatts; and a grid-connected capacity of 5,554 megawatts. The company was formerly known as Tianjin Quanyechang (Group) Co., Ltd. The company was founded in 1997 and is based in Beijing, China.
